name: com.wooshii.hierarchydecorator
description:
Hierarchy Decorator turns the Unity Hierarchy into a readable, informative workspace: headers, separators, tree guide lines, component icons and problem indicators - built natively on the Unity 6.6 Hierarchy window with UI Toolkit.

Originally created by Damian Slocombe (WooshiiDev). Modernized for Unity 6.6+.

samples.description: Editor tooling that generates 100 / 1k / 10k GameObject hierarchies for measuring decoration cost.
